question.problem:
Find the scale factor of the transformation represented by the rotation-scaling matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2} & -2\sqrt{3} \\ 2\sqrt{3} & \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
The scale factor $r$ of the rotation-scaling matrix $[\begin{aligned}a & -b \\ b & a\end{aligned}]$ can be found using the formula 

$$
r=\sqrt{det(A)}=\sqrt{{a}^{2}+{b}^{2}}.
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =\sqrt{det(A)} \\  & =\sqrt{{(\frac{1}{2})}^{2}+{(2\sqrt{3})}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{1}{4}+12} \\  & =\sqrt{\frac{49}{4}} \\  & =\frac{7}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
